title: The Healers' Round
offer: You are ready. Do my round alone today: look at the lambs in Ålberga, the horses in Torsgården and the swans in Svanetorp. Then come and tell me.

steps.say: You look in their eyes, their ears, their hooves... All well? Good! They like you.
Bror is old, but well. Silke's new foal is strong. Tell Tova all is fine.
The swans? Fat and happy. One has a sore wing: you wrapped it well.
All well, and the swan's wing wrapped? Then take this: your own healer's bag. You are healers now.

fact: Healers looked, listened and touched: they had no tools but their hands and their herbs.
